screen.reason: The study evaluates adding a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module to a predictive/imaging classifier to assess its effect on accuracy under missingness/ambiguity and evaluates clinician utility via physician review.

primary.practice: retrieval-augmented generation for evidence grounding and error correction
